summary: Combine the web developer bar's build identity and recent changes into one trigger and popover

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Web client developer bar only; the device-local changes seen cursor keeps its storage key and format, and changes are now marked seen once the first entry is wholly visible in the open popover.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting the web client restores the separate build and changes segments.
